item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This reads like a chapter from a history text book.

This kept me interested like a well-written SCP.

The ending gave me shivers like those emotional moments in movies.

This is so good its not fair. Take your +1 before I feel too inferior.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This hits all the right notes for me. The moment when the photograph is snapped is written in a wonderfully evocative manner that lends an appropriately epic feel to the story. For lack of a better word, this is just so…cool.

Well done. +1

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: The form of the story reminds me a little bit of the Secret Projects from Alpha Centauri…short, to the point, yet beautifully characterized and more than just a little bit thought-provoking. Thanks for writing it Smapti, I love your AWCY? works.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I feel like I would like this more if it were part of a somewhat larger backstory structure, if even in a series rather than a single tale. Also, the origination of the phrase 'Are We Cool Yet?' seems a bit, I don't know, forced, I guess. I guess I'm just not feeling that part. Overall it's a pretty cool concept though. AWCY is a bit nicer when it has some history behind it. Good job there.

item.content:encoded: Nice! I get a rather Mage: the Ascension kind of feeling from this…Historical figures posed in a secret world, that sort of thing. Neat! (That's meant as a compliment, heh…)
